items.html: Now there is no longer a distance of more than three degrees between any of the aforementioned lights and its vessel, for a distance of more than three degrees is a complete distance, and it cannot illuminate it. Indeed, the other lights also descended from their place, except for Tifferet, which remained in its place as above and did not descend. It is found, without doubt, that although we explained that the descent of the other lights was for the sake of the vessels, to illuminate them, still, being below their place, their power weakened somewhat, and therefore they do not have the power to rise upward. But the light of Tifferet, which remained in its place and whose taste and power did not change, is strong. Therefore, upon seeing itself without a vessel, it is possible for it to rise to the place from which it came out, since it does not wish to remain naked and exposed without a garment, and to return to Bina, to the place where it first stood. And if it does so, it is found to become very distant from its vessel, and it will die completely.
